root.label: G20 trade ministers deadlock on overcapacity and forced labor

events.label: G20 trade ministers deadlock on overcapacity and forced labor

slots.name: overcapacity agreement status
slots.sentence: G20 trade ministers failed to agree on tackling excess industrial capacity and eliminating forced labour from supply chains, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Thursday.

slots.name: food weaponisation consensus status
slots.sentence: But G20 countries did find consensus against "the weaponisation of food through coercive trade actions," Greer said.

slots.name: G20 presidency holder
slots.sentence: The United States holds the G20's rotating presidency this year.
